mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, significantly reducing ritonavir plasma concentrations and compromising HIV protease inhibition and boosting effects.
action: Contraindicated combination - St. John's wort must be avoided in patients taking ritonavir or ritonavir-boosted antiretroviral regimens; counsel patients on avoidance and consider alternative mood support.
